name: Compromise amendment
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 6a. Welcomes the Commission communication of 26 February 2026 on the European Citizens’ Initiative (ECI) ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’ (C(2026)3225), which clarifies that Member States may use the ESF+ to improve equal access to legally available and affordable healthcare services, including safe abortion services; calls on the Member States to make use of the ESF+ for this purpose, in line with the Commission’s clarification that this falls within their prerogative;
